propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos beati Polycarpi Martyris tui atque Pontificis annua
solemnitate laetificas: concede propitius; ut, cujus natalicia colimus, de
ejusdem etiam protectione gaudeamus. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: God, you gladden us with the annual solemnity of blessed Polycarp, your martyr and bishop. Graciously grant that we who honor his birthday may also rejoice in his protection. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Munera tibi, Domine, dicata sanctifica: et, intercedente beato Polycarpo
Martyre tuo atque Pontifice, per eadem nos placatus intende. Per Dominum
nostrum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Sanctify the gifts dedicated to you, Lord, and, through the intercession of blessed Polycarp, your martyr and bishop, be appeased by these same gifts and look upon us. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Refecti participatione muneris sacri, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster: ut,
cujus exsequimur cultum, intercedente beato Polycarpo Martyre tuo atque
Pontifice, sentiamus effectum. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Nourished by sharing in the sacred gift, we ask, Lord our God, that, through the intercession of blessed Polycarp, your martyr and bishop, we may experience the effect of what we celebrate in worship. Through our Lord.
